IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Roach, McCune, Upthegrove, Orcutt, Jarrett, and Condotta

Bill.BriefDescription: Reducing the license fee on single-axle trailers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reducing the license fee on single-axletrailers; amending RCW 46.16.086; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.16.086 and 2006 c 337 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In lieu of the license tab fees provided in RCW 46.16.0621, privateuse singleaxle trailers of two thousand pounds scale weight or lessmay be licensed upon the payment of a license fee in the sum of fifteendollars, but only if the trailer is operated upon public highways. Thelicense fee must be collected ((annually)) every three years for eachregistration ((year)) period or fraction of a registration ((year))period. This reduced license fee applies only to trailers operated forpersonal use of the owners, and not trailers held for rental to thepublic or used in any commercial or business endeavor. The proceedsfrom the fees collected under this section shall be distributed inaccordance with RCW 46.68.035(2).
